jobs.title: 定位 MV 母版：这台机上的 v721/v718 到底在哪
jobs.cmd: python -c "import os,glob,json;pats=['**/full_mv_v72*.mp4','**/full_mv_v718.mp4','**/*reel*.mp4'];hits=[];[hits.append(p) for pat in pats for p in glob.glob(pat,recursive=True)];hits=sorted(set(hits))[:20];os.makedirs('cph4/fleet/queue-receipts',exist_ok=True);json.dump({'node_hint':os.environ.get('COMPUTERNAME',''),'cwd':os.getcwd(),'hits':[{'p':h,'mb':round(os.path.getsize(h)/1048576,1)} for h in hits]},open('cph4/fleet/queue-receipts/mv-master-locate.json','w'),ensure_ascii=False,indent=1);print('hits',len(hits))"
